description: One restrained elegant woodland ivy vine corner overlay for an enchanted forest game's wooden board frame, isolated on TRANSPARENT background. A sparse inverted-L silhouette: a single gently bent stem follows the TOP and LEFT sides, bending around the upper-left corner. Only FIVE broad readable ivy leaves total, three along the top sweep and two descending the left sweep. Quiet long connected stem, mature dark sage-green leaves, no tiny leaves or noise. Outer canvas 64x64, keep at least 4px transparent padding all around. Keep the lower-right 40x40 region EMPTY TRANSPARENT, so the overlay never covers the board interior. Refined ancient woodland feel, sturdy and graceful, not goofy or cute clipart. Controlled dark outline, 2 to 3 broad matte leaf planes, restrained top-left highlights, native pixel-art clusters. No wood frame, no flowers, no berries, no mushrooms, no spirals, no lamps, no particles, no gemstones, no text, no entire scene. This is a small separate foliage accent, not a filled leafy border.
